list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: La-containing octameric polyoxotungstate comprising tungstoantimonate and tungstobismuthate segments
list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The discrete, dumbbell-shaped polyoxoanion has a central Krebs-type tungstobismuthate dimer linking two identical trimeric tungstoantimonate units through Bi–O–W bonds. Each terminal trimer contains three B-α-SbW9O33 fragments surrounding a face-sharing Bi6-oxo/La3-oxo core; the two trimers together contain six La ions. The central dimer contains two B-β-BiW9O33 fragments and four additional W atoms.

synthesis.ph: Adjusted to 5.0 before and after La(NO3)3·6H2O addition; 5.3 after crystallization.
synthesis.procedure: Successively dissolve the antimonotungstate precursor, sodium tungstate dihydrate, dimethylammonium chloride, sodium acetate trihydrate and sodium carbonate in 20 mL water with stirring. Add the bismuth nitrate pentahydrate solution in 6 M HCl dropwise, adjust to pH 5.0 with 2 M NaOH, add lanthanum nitrate hexahydrate and readjust to pH 5.0. Stir for 10 min, heat in a 90 °C water bath for 0.5 h, cool to ambient temperature and filter. Slowly evaporate the filtrate to obtain block crystals after approximately two weeks.
synthesis.temperature: 90 °C water bath for 0.5 h; then ambient temperature
synthesis.time: 10 min stirring after pH readjustment; 0.5 h heating; approximately two weeks crystallization
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Conventional aqueous solution method; water bath followed by slow evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Cool to ambient temperature, filter, then slowly evaporate the filtrate to obtain block crystals.

title: A La-containing poly(polyoxometalate) simultaneously comprising tungstoantimonate and tungstobismuthate segments: synthesis, structure and catalysis
